faqs.q: Is the toss market really predictable?
faqs.a: While the outcome is random, the odds are not. You are trading the market's assessment of the toss, which often overlooks key pitch-specific factors.
Toss markets usually open several minutes before the scheduled start. Check your Cricbet99 dashboard regularly.

faqs.q: Can I bet on both sides?
faqs.a: Yes, you can trade both sides of the toss to guarantee a profit regardless of the outcome, a classic arbitrage strategy.
